title: Grade 1 Science - Plants Around Us
text: Plants are living things. Many plants have roots, stems, leaves, flowers, fruits, and seeds. Children observe plants near home or school and talk about how plants need water, air, sunlight, and care. This is original teacher-created semantic reference content.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Recognize plants as living things and name simple plant needs.

title: Grade 2 Mathematics - Place Value
text: Learners understand that two-digit and three-digit numbers are made from hundreds, tens, and ones. They compare numbers, read number names, and use bundles or blocks to show value. This is original teacher-created semantic reference content.

metadata.subject: Mathematics
metadata.learning_objective: Represent numbers using hundreds, tens, and ones.

title: Grade 3 Science - Plant Parts and Functions
text: Plants have parts that help them live. Roots hold the plant and absorb water. Stems support the plant and carry water. Leaves help the plant make food using sunlight. Flowers can become fruits with seeds. This is original teacher-created semantic reference content.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Describe the basic functions of roots, stems, leaves, flowers, fruits, and seeds.
metadata.source_reference: original curriculum alignment note, not publisher text

title: Grade 4 English - Nouns
text: A noun names a person, place, animal, thing, or idea. Learners identify common nouns and proper nouns in sentences and use capital letters for proper nouns. This is original teacher-created semantic reference content.

metadata.subject: English
metadata.learning_objective: Identify and use common and proper nouns correctly.
metadata.source_reference: original curriculum alignment note, not publisher text

title: Grade 5 Science - Water Cycle
text: The water cycle explains how water moves through evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection. Heat from the Sun changes water into water vapour. Water vapour cools to form clouds, and water returns as rain, snow, or hail. This is original teacher-created semantic reference content.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Explain evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection in the water cycle.
metadata.source_reference: original curriculum alignment note, not MOE textbook text
